headline: X Money is launching in the US starting today
summary: Elon Musk's X Money launches in the US today, expanding his 'everything app' vision. Features a digital wallet, peer-to-peer payments, and an optional metal Visa card. Users can link their X username to the card and utilize Apple Wallet support.

headline: Razer’s analog Huntsman V3 Pro is over 20 percent off
summary: Razer's Huntsman V3 Pro TKL gaming keyboard is currently over 20 percent off. Features advanced adjustable optical switches for greater customization and faster response. This compact, wired keyboard marks an evolution in gaming input technology.

headline: Xbox’s huge outage even blocked games on disc
summary: A major Xbox outage not only affected digital games but also blocked disc-based titles. The widespread issue prevented users from logging in, launching apps, or finding games. The extended service disruption began Sunday evening, causing significant player frustration.

headline: Nanoleaf’s colorful pegboard and shelf kit is half off
summary: Nanoleaf's Blocks Combo XL Smarter Kit is now 50% off, priced at a new low of $99.99. The kit combines colorful smart lighting panels with a practical shelf and pegboard. It offers a fun, customizable way to add light and storage to any wall.

headline: Xbox Executive Explains Outage, Vows to 'Do Better'
summary: Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet addressed the recent system outage impacting game libraries and sign-ins. He provided transparency regarding the widespread issues from Sunday night through Monday. Van Vliet committed to 'do better,' acknowledging the frustration caused to players.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Is Projected to Have the Biggest Opening of 2026
summary: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' is projected to have the biggest box office opening of 2026. The film is on track to 'absolutely obliterate' previous box office records. This indicates massive anticipation and a potential blockbuster success.

headline: Avengers: Secret Wars Is the Only MCU Movie in 2027 as Kevin Feige Promises Quality Over Quantity
summary: 'Avengers: Secret Wars' is confirmed as the sole MCU movie release for 2027. Kevin Feige emphasized Marvel Studios' commitment to 'quality over quantity.' This strategy aims to ensure higher caliber films from the franchise.

headline: Call of Duty: Black Ops Fans Discover Cut Zombies Content Over 15 Years After Release
summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops fans have discovered new, previously cut Zombies mode content. The significant find comes over 15 years after the game's original release. This unearths fresh details about the popular classic mode for dedicated players.

headline: Schools to offer technical subjects to pupils from age 14, Burnham says
summary: UK schools will introduce technical subjects like AI and manufacturing for pupils aged 14 and up. The initiative aims to link education directly with local job market needs. This move seeks to equip students with skills relevant to modern industries.

headline: On the front line of Ecuador's drugs war, police fight gangs, guns and corruption
summary: Ecuador's police are on the front line, battling a massive surge in drug crime. Officers contend with powerful gangs, widespread gun violence, and internal corruption. The BBC joined patrols to witness the challenges faced in the country's escalating drug war.

headline: Reform UK reports Zack Polanski to police over guillotine T-shirt post
summary: Reform UK has reported Zack Polanski to the police over a social media post. The controversial post featured a T-shirt with the name 'Nigel' and a guillotine image. This incident has prompted a police investigation into the Green Party deputy leader.

headline: Johnson & Johnson offers up to $5.5bn to settle US baby powder lawsuits
summary: Johnson & Johnson offers up to $5.5 billion to settle thousands of US baby powder lawsuits. The proposed settlement aims to conclude a years-long legal battle. Claims allege the company's talc products are linked to cancer.
